_comment: Point-cost constants and Power Level caps for Mutants & Masterminds 4e (Open Game Content). Numeric game-mechanical facts only, per docs/mm-core-mechanics.md §7 — no rulebook prose. Consumed by mm_companion.core.data_loader; core reads these rather than hardcoding costs in Python.
_trait_ranges_comment: The range each trait family's sheet control accepts. Both spin boxes hold the bought rank - a resistance's ranks are what was bought on top of the trait it derives from, and its derived base and total are read-outs beside them. The resistance range stays the wider of the two because it once held that total, and narrowing it could only clamp ranks a character already has.
